mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate relative to historical averages compresses the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors seek yield in equities.
failure_condition: In periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%, the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day forward returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 5-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained year-over-year CPIAUCSL increase above 5.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain high interest rates and suppress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day forward returns in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL is above 5.0% (year-over-year), or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL as a predictor of 60-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in nonfarm payrolls signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term between UNRATE (decreasing) and PAYEMS (increasing) does not yield a positive Rank IC of at least 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where both conditions hold.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market expansion regime characterized by rising housing starts, consumer confidence in the housing sector increases, leading to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods of housing market expansion (HOUST above 1400 thousand units), the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day forward returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for HOUST as a predictor of 60-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate relative to historical averages indicates a tight labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when UNRATE is below 4.0%, the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day forward returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for UNRATE as a predictor of 5-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100.0 (index 2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing, reducing corporate earnings and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day forward returns in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.0, or the Rank IC for INDPRO as a predictor of 60-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high federal funds rates (above 4.5%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL above 5.0%) signals a monetary policy tightening cycle, increasing the cost of capital and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term between FEDFUNDS (above 4.5%) and CPIAUCSL (above 5.0%) does not yield a negative Rank IC of at least -0.05 over any 3-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both conditions hold.

mechanism_narrative: During a Federal Reserve monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising at least 0.5% in 3 months), the increased cost of borrowing reduces liquidity and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods of monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS rising at least 0.5% in 3 months), the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day forward returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 60-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
